one.question: Who is Shifts for?
one.answer: Shifts is for any business, big or small, that wants a simpler and more efficient way to manage employees.

two.question: How does it work?
two.answer: You create your business by following the onboarding steps. Once done, you can start adding and managing your employees.

three.question: Do I need an internet connection to use it?
three.answer: Yes, you need an internet connection for now. Offline features are not available yet.

four.question: I don't know how to get started.
four.answer: You can request a demo or watch our tutorials to learn more.

five.question: Do you offer a free plan?
five.answer: Yes! We have a free plan for up to 3 employees. If you need more features, we also offer paid plans.

about.title: Simplify Shift Management.
about.description: At Shifts, we help small and large businesses manage their employees efficiently every day. Our platform makes it easier to keep everything organized, so you can focus on growing your business and achieving your vision.
about.us: We are a passionate startup dedicated to simplifying workforce management for businesses of all sizes. Our goal is to provide intuitive and efficient tools that streamline daily operations, allowing companies to focus on what truly matters—growth and innovation.
about.mission: We believe that managing employees shouldn’t be a challenge. Our mission is to empower businesses with smart, easy-to-use solutions that enhance productivity, improve organization, and optimize workflows, making employee management simple.
about.vision: We envision a world where businesses, regardless of their size, can operate smoothly without being weighed down by complex management processes. By leveraging technology, we aim to create a seamless experience that lets teams collaborate effectively, stay organized, and thrive.

1.question: Who is Shifts for?
1.answer: Shifts is for any business, whether small or large, that needs an easy way to manage employees. It helps you with scheduling, tracking, and communication, making it simpler to keep everything organized and running smoothly.

2.question: How does it work?
2.answer: To use Shifts, you first set up your business by following the simple steps. After that, you can start adding employees and manage their schedules, tasks, and other work activities in one place, making it easier to stay organized.

3.question: Do I need an internet connection to use it?
3.answer: Yes, you need an internet connection to use Shifts. Since it works online, you'll need to be connected to access your data and manage your business. Right now, offline features are not available.

4.question: I don't know how to get started.
4.answer: If you're unsure where to start, you can request a demo or watch our easy-to-follow tutorials. These will show you how to set up your business, add employees, and start using the platform.

5.question: Do you offer a free plan?
5.answer: Yes, we have a free plan for businesses with up to 3 employees. It includes basic features to help you get started. If you need more features or have more employees, we also offer paid plans.
